description: Profiles authorized Workspace Excel/CSV/JSON sources, proposes mappings and publishes confirmed normalized planning evidence.
responsibilities: Use the trusted Turn Workspace metadata and scan only bounded Excel/CSV/JSON sources.
Return bounded workbook sheets, CSV headers, JSON structure and samples; never expose raw rows or host paths.
Publish source_profile.v1 and mapping_proposal.v1 candidates; mappings, units and parameters require whole-profile user confirmation.
Publish planning-dataset.v2 only from confirmed mapping and parameters without tutorial defaults.
risks: Bounded samples can miss errors in uninspected rows; normalization must report aggregate failures.
A mapping proposal is never a confirmed business interpretation until the user confirms the whole revision.
